input.description: Run up to 10 primitive calls in one round trip for one x402 payment of $0.02 (= $0.0020 per call, below the priciest single-call route at $0.01). Each request names an `endpoint` (normalize, validate, extract, redact, classify, dedupe, diff, chunk, extract_custom, validate_json, slugify, hash) and its input; results return in request order. Single payment, no streaming. Larger rungs cost less per call: /v1/batch/50 ($0.075, $0.0015/call) and /v1/batch/100 ($0.100, $0.0010/call).

network.description: Optional x402 network id (defaults to eip155:8453).
